args.summary: One device (FX-RAM-01, hostname fx-latitude-ram) shows persistent high memory usage, with RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 daily snapshots over the telemetry window. A second device (FX-RAM-02) had a brief spike but does not meet the persistent threshold.

claims.text: Device FX-RAM-01 (fx-latitude-ram) has persistent RAM constraint: RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 snapshots (71% share), max 3 consecutive days, on a 16 GB device.
Device FX-RAM-02 (fx-macbook-spike) had RAM at or above 95% on only 2 consecutive snapshots (14% share), not meeting the persistent threshold.
The ram_constrained detector checked 24 devices; 1 device had too few snapshots for a trend assessment.

caveats: One RAM reading per day: high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
Too few snapshots for a trend on 1 device(s) (a trend needs 7). Their latest snapshot was still checked, so this says nothing about their current state.
